## Summary

Describe the behavior or documentation change and link the relevant issue, if any.

## Browser and security impact

- Browser support and host permissions changed? Explain the exact change, or write “none”.
- Local storage schema, authentication, or network behavior changed? Explain, or write “none”.

## Verification

List commands actually run and any checks that remain unverified.

## Documentation

Link the updated guide or explain why no documentation change is needed. For complex file moves, an optional [mdxcn GraphDiff](https://mdxcn.dev/docs/graph-diff) fence can clarify the summary; copy its official Markdown representation rather than drawing a new one.
